func schedule(_ items: [Int], _ group: inout TaskGroup<Void>) {
  for item in items {
    Task { [item] in await work(item) }
    Task<Void, Never>(priority: .utility) { [item] in await work(item) }
    _Concurrency.Task(priority: .utility) { await work(item) }
    let task = Task(priority: .utility) { [item] in await work(item) }
    group.addTask(priority: .utility) { [item] in await work(item) }
    group.addTaskUnlessCancelled { [item] in await work(item) }
    handles.append(task)
  }
}

func repeated(_ items: [Int]) async {
  for item in items {
    let task = Task { [item] in await work(item) }
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
    await task.value
    Task(priority: .utility) { [item] in
      for child in children(item) {
        // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
        await work(child)
      }
    }
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-swift
    Task(priority: await choosePriority(item)) { [item] in await work(item) }
  }
}
